WebBrowserNavigateTo: Blueberry Scones - Tender, buttery scones packed with fresh blueberries and finished with a lemon glaze. Prep 15 min, bake 20 min.
Ingredients: 2 cups flour, 1/3 cup sugar, 1 tbsp baking powder, 1/2 cup cold butter, 1 cup blueberries, 2/3 cup cream, 1 egg.
Preheat oven to 400F. Cut cold butter into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs, then fold in the blueberries gently.
Rated 4.8 out of 5 by 312 home bakers. Tip: freeze the berries first so they do not bleed into the dough.
Coded Culinary | Recipes for busy people. Blueberry Scones: easy weekend baking that takes under 40 minutes start to finish.
Shape the dough into an 8-inch circle, cut into 8 wedges, brush with cream, and sprinkle with coarse sugar before baking.
Storage: keep in an airtight container for up to 2 days, or freeze unbaked wedges and bake straight from frozen, adding 3 to 5 minutes.
Blueberry Scones recipe. Jump to recipe. Print recipe. Nutrition per scone: 290 calories, 13g fat, 38g carbs, 5g protein.
